data.one_liner: Bidirectional Server Sent Events client and server for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a client and server implementation of a bidirectional protocol built on Server‑Sent Events. Both sides expose a sink and a stream so messages can be sent and received. Designed for scenarios where WebSockets are unavailable.
use_when: You need real‑time, bidirectional communication in a Dart/Flutter app and WebSockets cannot be used
Both client and server are written in Dart and can share the same protocol
You want automatic reconnect and out‑of‑order handling for SSE connections
avoid_when: You need a general‑purpose SSE library that works with any server implementation
You can use WebSockets or other protocols that offer richer features
You require support for non‑Dart backends
strengths: Client and server are provided together, ensuring compatibility
Handles reconnects, out‑of‑order messages and provides logging
Works on web and server platforms
weaknesses: Only works with a matching server from the same package
Not a generic SSE client for arbitrary servers
